description: Bare cottonwood trees, seen from above, stand on dry brown and gray earth. The trees' limbs appear like soft, gray clouds above their trunks. A fence runs diagonally through the landscape. Two small, green bushes add color to the image.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
